research_basis.limits: The one hundred concept scores are comparative editorial estimates, not predicted CTR. The vidIQ figures are directional snapshots, and the pasted citation tokens are not reusable source links. Operator decisions and measured upload outcomes outrank this pool.
adopted_findings: own-channel demand and immediate emotional clarity deserve the largest package weights
betrayal or humiliation is the mandatory premise chassis for every candidate, never a competing idea lane
the healthy mix comes from changing the reversal engine after the betrayal: explicit systems, fortune, genius, supernatural partners, magical boons, or original high-scaling mechanics

recent niche winners materially support forbidden mechanics, measurable multipliers, and human betrayal paired with a corrective reversal engine; current own-channel evidence decides whether rank or institution shorthand transfers to this channel
the reversal engine is secondary to the plain human betrayal and visible loss, but every candidate still needs one clear engine

the current own-channel catalog shows a 38.27-times median raw-view advantage for familiar money and status mechanics over abstract rank ladders; use that as a controlled ten-premise prior while retaining impression and distribution caveats
identity comedy and supernatural romance remain valid challengers when the social reversal is instantly legible; the suppressed default is rank-ladder abstraction, not fantasy itself
the repeated asset-theft-plus-multiplier package is a reliable floor rather than proven ceiling; do not mistake one working grammar for the whole channel
acquisition, ownership, and public status transfer more directly from the strongest money videos than self-improvement alone
the first mobile-visible title phrase must expose both the wound and the reversal engine rather than spending scarce characters on a redundant lover clause
one proof object or relationship should make the reversal phone-readable
documentary proof may enable an active reversal but must not become a procedural climax
rejected_findings: a rigid fifty-percent AI-generated supernatural quota
treating ranked concepts as a release queue
assuming Queen, Goddess, Empress, Spirit, or other fantasy-title substitution creates useful absurdity by itself

treating all systems, regression, or supernatural mechanics as inherently harmful; the current negative evidence applies specifically to abstract rank, gate, hunter, dungeon, guild, academy, and raid-party ladders

formula_statement: Every premise begins with a personally legible betrayal or humiliation that removes Joey's status, relationship, safety, work, or future. Joey makes an early irreversible boundary, receives or discovers one clear reversal engine, and uses its potentially overpowered or hyper-scaling effect to build an understandable ascent. The engine does not need to mirror the betrayal; it must causally power the promised transformation. The story explains how Joey converts that power into results at both the scale of his whole ascent and the moment of each decisive victory, imposing a visible loss on the betrayer while building a far larger life beyond them.

audience_promise.click_reason: See an unfair personal betrayal reversed completely and visibly.
emotional_sequence: enjoy simple premise-native choices and escalation
see the betrayer lose the exact thing they abused
audience_promise.non_negotiable: The title, thumbnail, opening, middle engine, climax, and final boundary must all express the same viewer fantasy.

current_channel_premise_prior.default_lane: A personally legible modern betrayal followed by one simple numerical or impossible advantage that compounds into familiar money, ownership, career, business, property, influence, reputation, or skill proof.
suppress_as_default: crystals used mainly as rank labels
allowed_challengers: identity comedy with a clear corrective mechanic
supernatural romance with a concrete human betrayal and visible social reversal
isekai or reincarnation with a one-breath human contradiction rather than a rank ladder
current_channel_premise_prior.selection_rule: Prefer a familiar social or financial receipt that a cold viewer can value instantly. An explicit operator request or new measured evidence is required to promote a rank-ladder premise during this test window.
current_channel_premise_prior.three_upload_shape_rule: For the active three-upload duration and ad test, use no more than two asset-theft-plus-unit-multiplier packages. The third upload should test a materially different proven channel desire such as identity comedy, hidden status, or supernatural romance while preserving immediate betrayal and readable revenge.
current_channel_premise_prior.measurement_rule: Exclude Shorts and compare longform packages using impressions, CTR, APV, AVD, traffic source, subscriber status, duration cohort, and release age rather than raw views alone.

reversal_engine_policy.operator_seed_policy: Preserve every supplied operator seed as a real finalist unless it violates literal title truth or duplicates a recorded rejection. AI challenges and develops operator seeds; it does not silently replace them.
reversal_engine_policy.mandatory_betrayal_spine: Every candidate must name who betrayed, rejected, abandoned, stole from, cursed, framed, cheated on, fired, disowned, or publicly humiliated Joey; state the literal act and concrete loss; then launch Joey into one primary reversal engine and a visible transformation.
reversal_engine_policy.sequence: CONCRETE BETRAYAL OR HUMILIATION -> ONE REVERSAL ENGINE -> EARLY VISIBLE PROOF -> HYPER-SCALING BUT CAUSALLY EXPLAINED ASCENT -> VISIBLE PAYBACK
reversal_engine_policy.discovery_rule: There are no fixed reversal-engine lanes, quotas, allowed-family enum, power ceiling, or mandatory nerf. Search freely for the strongest clear mechanic that can launch Joey's post-betrayal ascent. Systems, lotteries, genius, hidden identity, supernatural spouses, demons, gods, devils, ghosts, vampires, genies, wishing willows, curses, jobs, skills, objects, contracts, luck, status, and unfamiliar original mechanics are examples rather than boxes to fill.
reversal_engine_policy.batch_diversity_rule: The private raw pool should explore materially different mechanics and title movies. Never return six reskins of 'my wife or fiancee took one asset, then every unit became a multiplier,' one system, one spouse title, one fantasy noun, or one windfall. During the active three-upload test, at most two recommendations may use the same asset-theft-plus-unit-multiplier skeleton; include at least one evidence-backed shape-breaker from identity comedy, hidden status, supernatural romance, or another materially different viewer desire. Diversity breaks ties; it never outranks click strength, operator judgment, or a genuinely better premise.
reversal_engine_policy.selection_rule: Select finalists by package strength and story runway, not quota compliance. Preserve operator seeds. Do not reject an original mechanic because it does not fit a predefined family.

grounded_explanation_standard.definition: Grounded means every decisive result is explained through observable cause and effect inside the story's fictional rules. It does not mean realistic power limits.
grounded_explanation_standard.major_proof_chain: OBSTACLE OR TELL -> MECHANIC INPUT, OUTPUT, OR GRANTED CAPABILITY -> JOEY'S CONCRETE TACTIC OR EXECUTION -> OPPONENT OR ENVIRONMENT RESPONSE -> RESULT -> COMPARATIVE PROOF OF HOW OVERPOWERED HE IS
grounded_explanation_standard.capability_sufficiency: A result must be supported by capabilities the mechanic actually grants. Intelligence or analysis alone does not supply strength, reflexes, motor memory, capital, tools, credentials, or labor. Establish accelerated training, physical enhancement, perfect control, equipment, allies, capital, or another execution bridge when the result requires it.
grounded_explanation_standard.specificity_rule: Do not summarize a major win with vague claims such as Joey used his brain, used the system, used advanced tactics, easily won, outsmarted everyone, or built an empire. Name the relevant observation or power output, the tactic or action, why the obstacle reacted as expected, the resulting change, and one visible measure or comparison proving dominance.
grounded_explanation_standard.detail_calibration: Use the few concrete details needed to make the result inevitable and satisfying, normally one to three decisive tactical or technical facts. Avoid both unexplained outcomes and jargon dumps.
grounded_explanation_standard.required_package_examples: Before scripting, preserve at least two fully explained decisive applications: the first proof and the climax or another late-scale proof. These examples establish the engine's usable causal grammar without forcing the narration into a beat sheet.
grounded_explanation_standard.boxing_example: Bad: Joey used an intelligence system and outboxed a professional. Sufficient: the system identifies the professional's repeated tell, grants or accelerates the perception and motor control needed to exploit it, Joey deliberately baits the expected attack and executes a named counter, the professional commits to the trap, and the result includes a visible margin proving Joey was overwhelmingly superior rather than lucky. If the system grants analysis only, it cannot also grant professional reflexes or technique without training or another execution bridge.

reversal_engine_policy.rule: Every concept is betrayal first and reversal-engine second. The engine need not thematically counter or mirror the wound. It must be nameable in one short phrase, produce visible proof, support dramatic hyper-scaling, and causally power the title transformation. Unlimited, compounding, or wildly overpowered mechanics are welcome. Do not invent a limit, cost, cooldown, or weakness merely to balance them. Instead define the acquisition, effect, scaling rule, execution bridge, first proof logic, and the major causal steps that turn the mechanic into status, money, mastery, relationships, companies, kingdoms, or worlds. Joey supplies direction and concrete application; the engine may supply enormous power. Do not stack unrelated mechanics when one strong engine can carry the fantasy.

own_channel_demand_fit.question: Does the package transfer a measured demand pattern from the channel's strongest videos without copying their plot skin?

niche_outlier_support.question: Does a current niche outlier support the click grammar, emotional contradiction, or visible outcome?

instant_emotional_clarity.question: Can a cold viewer understand the relationship, betrayal, and reversal without lore?

literal_complete_title_reversal.question: Does the title state the concrete wound and the complete literal transformation rather than merely setting up a mystery?

one_glance_thumbnail_proof.question: Can one simple thumbnail scene prove the emotional conflict and the reversal at phone size?

thumbnail_additivity.question: Does the thumbnail add proof, judgment, or status instead of repeating the title?

power_fantasy_engine_and_causal_scaling.question: After the mandatory betrayal, does one clear reversal engine deliver an exciting power fantasy with visible acceleration or hyper-scaling? Does each major proof explain the obstacle, mechanic output or granted capability, Joey's concrete execution, the response, the result, and a visible comparison proving how overpowered he is? Can the premise bridge every required capability without artificially nerfing the mechanic or using vague claims such as he used his intelligence or simply outsmarted them?

fresh_from_recent_uploads.question: Is the central relationship, advantage, setting, and payoff meaningfully different from recent uploads?

longform_runway.question: Can one central conflict and one primary mechanic keep escalating for an hour through increasingly large goals, proofs, applications, relationships, rivals, and consequences without adding unrelated systems, repeated humiliation, or procedural filler?

retention_architecture.rule: This is a post-generation review log, not a source-release gate. It may identify likely slow, repetitive, or overlong spans for optional human review, but it never triggers automatic rewriting, regeneration, or ingest blocking. Upload retention—not an LLM checklist—decides whether the formula works.

pairing: Score the title and thumbnail as one package, not as independent assets.
The title explains the causal movie; the thumbnail either hard-proves its strongest hook with a concrete receipt or adds a consequential payoff.
The pair must sell the same fantasy, avoid empty verbal repetition, and create one compelling unresolved how or why question.
Every package must name title_supplies, thumbnail_adds, package_open_loop, proof_device, and literal_payment_scene before scripting.
Reject attractive-character-plus-arrow packages whose only overlay is a broad verdict without a visible number, rank, UI, object, action, role change, or transformation.
title: Use one plain causal sentence.

Assume mobile browse may expose only the first fifty-five characters. Put the concrete wound and enough of the reversal engine inside that visible prefix; remove redundant clauses such as 'for her lover' when the thumbnail already supplies the affair.
Name the relationship or institution that betrayed Joey.
State the concrete betrayal.
State the concrete reversal, takeback, exposure, alliance, or new status.
Use at most one impossible contradiction, and require it to materially drive the ascent, conflict, visual identity, or payoff rather than merely decorate the title.
Use no unexplained lore term as the click hinge.
Make every verb, count, rank, relationship, and payoff literally true in the eventual script.
thumbnail: Use one scene, not a collage.
Prefer Joey and one antagonist or contrast figure.
Use one dominant prop, gesture, relationship, or status proof.
Prefer a specific receipt: a number, rank change, system screen, physical action, status object, role substitution, or before-after consequence.
Use one to four main words and at most eight overlay words total.
Use zero arrows by default; use one only when evidence supports the same transfer, identity, or direction job. A second requires separate evidence.
Either reinforce the title with a visible receipt or add a truthful consequence; never repeat title wording over decorative art.
Generate the complete final sixteen-by-nine thumbnail from scratch with Codex Imagen; supply zero image references of any kind.
Require Codex Imagen to render the exact text, labels, and arrows inside the finished raster; local work is limited to resize, format conversion, and compression, never content compositing or repair.
opening: Choose linear_title_event, direct_premise, or outcome_choice_rewind before drafting. Use outcome_choice_rewind only when one concrete later result and one Joey refusal make the package easier to understand than the opening lore.

For outcome_choice_rewind, show one result, one satisfying decision, and one clean rewind that adds cause rather than replaying the preview. The cold open may use first person and shift once into third person after the rewind.
During the first thirty seconds, introduce at most one new proper name and two unexplained story terms. Prefer concrete people, objects, status, wounds, and choices over lore density.
Show the title contradiction through a physical or social event in the first thirty seconds.
Give three to five non-redundant receipts of exploitation when the betrayal needs accumulation.
Cross the irreversible line and give Joey a meaningful refusal, escape, or boundary by minutes three to five.

Prove the core advantage and show its scaling direction by approximately minutes six to eight through an obstacle, mechanic output, execution bridge, concrete tactic, obstacle response, result, and visible dominance comparison.
Enter the larger premise-native objective by minute ten.
middle: Move beyond replaying the opening humiliation.
Use eight to ten causal movements with changing objectives, pressure, relationships, resources, status, information, or environment.

For every major proof or decisive victory, explain the short local chain from obstacle through mechanic output, execution, response, result, and visible margin of dominance. Do not substitute a label such as intelligence, advanced tactics, or outsmarting for the action itself.
Keep the antagonist competent and evidence-bound.
Create meaningful pressure through larger goals, intelligent opposition, responsibility, speed, complexity, or scale. Do not require a defeat or nerf the mechanic merely to manufacture tension.
Let allies materially change at least one rescue, comeback, or climax.
ending: Resolve the title promise in an active physical or social scene whose decisive mechanism, execution, response, and result are visible and causally sufficient.
Cause a concrete loss tied to the original exploitation.
End with one concise changed equilibrium and no second ending.

hard_reject_codes.setup_only_title: The title promises only the wound and hides the transformation.
hard_reject_codes.abstract_click_hinge: The click depends on lore, an undefined rank, a metaphor, or a vague claim.
hard_reject_codes.thumbnail_repeats_title: The thumbnail merely restates the title instead of proving or extending it.
hard_reject_codes.thumbnail_collage: The thumbnail requires a collage, crowd, or too many labels to understand.
hard_reject_codes.passive_joey: Joey continues serving the betrayer after understanding the harm without a strategic boundary.
hard_reject_codes.engine_replaces_joey_agency: The reversal engine chooses Joey's goal, morality, or decisive victory instead of supplying leverage for his choices.
hard_reject_codes.unexplained_power_application: A major victory is credited to intelligence, genius, the system, luck, advanced tactics, or raw power without showing the relevant mechanic output, required execution capability, concrete action, obstacle response, result, and visible proof of dominance.
hard_reject_codes.repeated_humiliation_engine: The middle repeats the opening humiliation with new names.
hard_reject_codes.paperwork_climax: A hearing, contract, lawsuit, report, or technicality creates the decisive victory.
hard_reject_codes.unearned_antagonist_collapse: The antagonist becomes incompetent or confesses without evidence-based pressure.
hard_reject_codes.weak_symmetric_payoff: The betrayer does not visibly lose something connected to the original harm.
hard_reject_codes.recent_signature_duplicate: The premise substantially repeats a recent relationship, mechanic, setting, and payoff combination.
hard_reject_codes.production_identity_overload: The story needs too many recurring characters, monsters, props, or location states to remain visually coherent.
hard_reject_codes.random_fantasy_mad_lib: The supernatural element is a replaceable Queen, Goddess, Empress, Spirit, creature, or magical object that does not materially change the progression, decisions, visual identity, escalation, or payoff.

evidence.lesson: A complete causal title can carry betrayal, loss, a simple numerical advantage, and a concrete takeback.

evidence.lesson: A personal rival plus a one-line numerical mechanic makes the transformation easy to understand.

evidence.title: I Spent $184,730 on Her, Then My 10X System Exposed Her | Manhwa Recap
evidence.lesson: A precise receipt makes exploitation tangible, while a simple exposure payoff completes the promise.

evidence.title: She Dumped Me for the Hero—Now I Awakened VILLAIN System To Crush Them! - Manhwa Recap in Hindi
evidence.lesson: A public romantic rejection paired with one named corrective system creates an immediate human wound, a manhwa-native click hinge, and an explicit revenge direction.

evidence.title: Reincarnating With EVERY DEATH, He Evolves 100x Faster Than Anyone - Manhwa Recap
evidence.lesson: One repeatable manhwa mechanic plus a measurable multiplier supplies both instant title clarity and a natural progression engine.

evidence.title: Used as a Meat Shield for Years, He Left Her and Became the Strongest Tank
evidence.lesson: Concrete abuse, early withdrawal, a premise-native adventure, and calm evidence-based revenge outperform repeated ranting.

evidence.title: Isekai'd as a Slave, He Was Bought by a Single Mother to Be Her Husband
evidence.lesson: One legible status contradiction and one relationship transformation can carry the complete package.

evidence.title: My Bride Ran Away Before The Wedding, So I Married Her Billionaire Aunt | Manhwa Recap
evidence.lesson: A simple relationship substitution creates immediate betrayal, reversal, and thumbnail clarity without lore.

negative_evidence.lesson: Rank, gates, technical lore, and formal checklist completion do not replace an emotionally simple wound, quick human choice, escalating causal movements, and a literal reversal. Presence-only gates can pass a script that viewers abandon.

recent_signature_policy.source: Read the current channel upload ledger during ideation when available.
recent_signature_policy.allowed_transfer: Reuse winning emotional grammar, not the same plot skin.
